name: stack-word-key
hypothesis: Avoid heap allocation for constructing the `word|TOKEN` state-feature key for tokens up to 250 bytes by using a 256-byte stack buffer, keeping an exact heap fallback for longer tokens.

diagnostic.build_request: Apply this exact crf.patch to a fresh 185-diagnostic-instrumentation/source/prototype181 copy, preserving diag_alloc and lookup hooks. Add diagnostic-only stack-key/heap-fallback counters so coverage of the fixed buffer boundary is explicit.

supported: allocator calls and requested bytes in CRF
output parity, one parsing thread, candidate throughput and peak/steady footprint

unavailable.key bytes copied into stack storage: Not currently counted by shared aggregate hooks; key content and fallback boundary are source-audited.
